dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello. So this is a restaurant...

dialogues.speaker: Gretchen
dialogues.text: Yes, please feel free to rest up here for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Gretchen
dialogues.text: As this is a lakeside restaurant, you can enjoy breathtaking views of the majestic scenery while enjoying our fine cuisine. You know, I spent quite a lot of time picking the location.

dialogues.speaker: Gretchen
dialogues.text: You may also notice that the angles at which the tables are arranged, the height and materials of the chairs have been meticulously calibrated.

dialogues.speaker: Gretchen
dialogues.text: This way, we can provide our guests with a delightful dining experience!
